stemBlocks.value: Evaluate (2.4 × 10⁴)/0.6 and (i) express your answer in standard form.
Think first: Separate the number part from the power of ten and divide only the number part.

stemBlocks.altText: Source visual for edmar-csec-p009-q05 from workbook page 9.

solutionSteps.instruction: Check the standard-form condition and state the ordinary value.

strategyBlocks.value: Divide 2.4 by 0.6 to get the front number, keep the 10⁴ unchanged, then confirm the result is already in standard form.

whyThisWorks.value: Division is associative over a product, so (2.4 × 10⁴) ÷ 0.6 can be regrouped as (2.4 ÷ 0.6) × 10⁴ — the power of ten is untouched because nothing was divided into it. Standard form then only requires the front number to sit between 1 and 10, and 4 already does, so no index adjustment is needed.

commonErrors.misconception: Dividing the index by 0.6 as well as the front number.
commonErrors.correctiveNote: Avoid this: Dividing the index by 0.6 as well as the front number.

commonErrors.misconception: Reading 2.4 ÷ 0.6 as 0.4 by misplacing the decimal point.
commonErrors.correctiveNote: Avoid this: Reading 2.4 ÷ 0.6 as 0.4 by misplacing the decimal point.

commonErrors.misconception: Writing 40 × 10³ and calling it standard form.
commonErrors.correctiveNote: Avoid this: Writing 40 × 10³ and calling it standard form.

examTip.value: Turn a decimal division into whole numbers by scaling both parts equally — 2.4 ÷ 0.6 becomes 24 ÷ 6, which you can do in your head.
